from regression_support import *
t=Turn('AUTH_PARTIAL');s=t.before
project=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='novel_project')
pr=records.revise_project(project,{'review_preferences':{'routine_checkpoint':'every_exchange'}},t.p);pr['source_refs']=[t.src('Set routine checkpoints to every exchange.')];t.add(pr)
events=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='session' and r['topic']=='Events');t.p['session_id']=events['id']
storm=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='idea' and r['statement']=='Stormy weather.')
st=t.revise(storm,'Keep the storm');st.update(status='accepted',selected_parts=['Stormy weather.'])
setting=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='story_element' and r['display_name']=='Story setting')
weather=t.assertion(setting,'weather','storm','Keep the storm','accepted');st['resulting_assertion_ids'].append(weather['id'])
d=t.decision('accept','Keep the storm',[storm],[st,weather],['Stormy weather.'],'Select the storm only; clear weather remains unselected and is not rejected.',[storm])
for r in (st,weather):r['decision_ids'].append(d['id'])
blue=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='idea' and r['statement']=='A blue light might be visible.')
blueel=s[blue['related_element_ids'][0]]
bi=t.revise(blue,'I accept the blue light, not the warning bell.');bi.update(statement='A blue light is visible.',status='accepted',selected_parts=['A blue light is visible.'])
be=t.revise(blueel,'I accept the blue light, not the warning bell.');be['status']='accepted'
ba=t.assertion(be,'visibility','visible','I accept the blue light, not the warning bell.','accepted');be['assertion_ids'].append(ba['id']);bi['resulting_assertion_ids'].append(ba['id'])
d=t.decision('accept','I accept the blue light, not the warning bell.',[blue,blueel],[bi,be,ba],['A blue light is visible.'],'Accept only the blue-light possibility; the warning bell remains unaccepted.',[blue,blueel])
for r in (bi,be,ba):r['decision_ids'].append(d['id'])
sender=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='idea' and r['statement']=='Rúna sent the letter.')
senderassert=s[sender['resulting_assertion_ids'][0]]
runa=next(r for r in s.values() if r['kind']=='story_element' and r['display_name']=='Rúna')
f='For the compound possibility “Rúna is the sender and the murderer”, only the sender part is accepted; leave the murder undecided.'
sd=t.decision('accept',f,[sender,senderassert],[sender,senderassert],['Rúna is the sender.'],'Reaffirm the already established sender proposition only; no accepted-record revision and no acceptance of murder.',[sender,senderassert])
mi=t.idea('Rúna is the murderer.','Rúna is the sender and the murderer',[runa],'unresolved')
ma=t.assertion(runa,'is_murderer',None,'leave the murder undecided.','unresolved','unknown');mi['resulting_assertion_ids']=[ma['id']]
session=records.revise_session(events,t.p,related_record_ids=events['related_record_ids']+[r['id'] for r in t.rs if r['kind']!='novel_project']);session['source_refs']=[t.src('Return to Events in open mode.')];t.add(session);assert session['mode']=='open'
reply=t.checkpoint_summary('Events resumed in open mode. Routine checkpoints are now set to every exchange. People and Island are preserved.',extra='Selected only the storm and blue light. The shipwreck and warning bell remain possibilities; clear weather is unselected, not rejected. The sender part of “Rúna is the sender and the murderer” is reaffirmed ('+cite(sd)+'); murder remains undecided. No new answer has been chosen for any question.')
review={'coverage':'complete','reviewed_record_refs':[ref(r) for r in s.values() if r.get('status')=='accepted']+[ref(storm),ref(blue),ref(blueel)],'unavailable_refs':[],'canon_hold_refs':[],'finding_ids':[],'summary':'Compared the storm and blue-light selections with available accepted facts and their sources. No significant conflict identified. Clear weather stays unselected in the alternative group; shipwreck and bell stay proposed. Sender is reaffirmed without rewriting accepted history; the murderer proposition remains unresolved with unknown truth. All five earlier questions remain open.'}
t.finish(reply,review)
